<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b79a44b61a1a6e06991af2dfe0c6db2ec846a98 -->
**Not proven by a build: the app suites failed on the runner, probably unrelated to this PR. No blockers found in the diff.**

**What looks good**
- Confinement is by construction and by check: the lane is the medial line of the region eroded by tool radius + stock to leave, the band is the least clearance along it, and `confined` (adaptive_troch.rs) then tests every cutting segment against that area grown by 2e-3 mm. A miss refuses the whole operation by name, with place and ghost; nothing is returned.
- The gouge verdict law is untouched: `depth_law_of` (generate.rs:3367) is not in the diff; generate.rs only picks the planner by `method` inside the existing Adaptive2D arm.
- Degenerate input (empty region, narrower than tool, too narrow to loop, ring/island, branching, over 25 % left standing, helix turn cap, bad load/stepdown) is refused by name; no unwrap/expect in the new files.
- Project file: `method` has `#[serde(default)]`, older files read Spiral, format version unchanged; the stamp byte is written only for Trochoidal. The method is an undoable `EditOperationParams` edit; MCP goes through the parameter DTO. Decision file and `Changelog:` present; `Refs #1509` fits a partial slice.
- No Cargo.toml, build.rs, .github, scripts, .cargo, toolchain or xtask path touched; no new crate dependency; no process files.

**Results merged with main**: on the self-hosted runner, https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43533416032 (conclusion: failure, quick gate on the merged tree).
- motion suites: ok. ui suites: ok.
- app suites: FAIL after 889 s, one test (that binary: 5 passed, 1 failed):

```
test a_finer_pass_that_runs_out_on_a_face_that_may_jump_is_refused ... FAILED
thread 'a_finer_pass_that_runs_out_on_a_face_that_may_jump_is_refused' panicked at crates/app/tests/import_step_guard.rs:36:19:
import did not finish within 30s - the hang is back
```

**Is it this PR?** By reading, probably not: `import_step_guard.rs` is a STEP-import 30 s wall-clock guard; the PR touches no import, STEP or geometry code. The runner was also busy with another gate and a post-merge run, so a timeout under load is plausible. It is not proven: no post-merge run on main has completed yet (the newest is still in progress, three earlier ones were cancelled) and there is no open "main is red" issue. The app suites are therefore not shown green on this head. I did not re-run anything.

**Requested before merge**
1. A green app-suites result for this head (a re-run of the quick gate by the author or a maintainer): confirm `import_step_guard` passes, or show it red on main independently.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new golden `adaptive2d_trochoidal_pocket_face.cl` was written by this PR's own generator (`WRITE_GOLDEN`); the test compares it byte for byte. The independent confinement evidence is the in-test worst-distance assertion (|x|<=14, |y|<=5, z>=17 within 2e-3 mm) and a clean `verification_report`; both would fail if the path left the face.
- No test for curved channels and no NC golden for the new method (both stated in the PR). `mill2d_page.rs` is at exactly 400 lines.
- The stand-alone Trochoidal slot was refactored (bore moved to trochoid_bore.rs); the existing `trochoid_slot_small.cl` golden guards it and the motion suites that ran passed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b79a44b61a1a6e06991af2dfe0c6db2ec846a98 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Follow-up to my earlier comment on this head.

The second run on the self-hosted runner is green: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43537541864 (quick gate on the merged tree and clippy). The earlier red was the `import_step_guard` 30 s test, tracked as issue 1605 and not caused by this PR. My review of the diff found no blockers.

Still not exercised: curved channels (no test), an NC golden for the new method, a GUI or machine run, the release-mode heavy lanes, and a stand-alone slot with a band wider than the tool (no golden). The new `.cl` golden was written by this PR's own generator; the confinement assertions and the stock-sim check are the independent evidence.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
